hooks.command: bash -c 'FILE=$(cat | jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty" 2>/dev/null); [[ "$FILE" == *.cs ]] && DOTNET_SYSTEM_GLOBALIZATION_INVARIANT=1 /home/coder/.dotnet/dotnet format /home/coder/workspace/backend/Calvin.BookingService.csproj --include "$FILE" 2>/dev/null; exit 0'

bash -c 'FILE=$(cat | jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty" 2>/dev/null); ([[ "$FILE" == *.ts ]] || [[ "$FILE" == *.tsx ]]) || exit 0; cd /home/coder/workspace/frontend && ./node_modules/.bin/eslint --fix "$FILE" 2>/dev/null; OUT=$(./node_modules/.bin/eslint --format compact "$FILE" 2>/dev/null); [[ -n "$OUT" ]] && jq -n --arg m "ESLint errors remain after autofix:\n$OUT" "{\"systemMessage\": \$m}"; exit 0'
